title: ‘개발 인허가 사기’ 최용규 전 의원 징역 2년…법정구속
caption:
Former lawmaker Choi Yong-gyu has received a two-year prison sentence for development fraud. The court ruled he exploited his legal background and district office experience to take 700 million won for permits he could not deliver. His accomplice failed to appear for sentencing.

Source: Seoul - ‘개발 인허가 사기’ 최용규 전 의원 징역 2년…법정구속
